title: LLM4POL selection plan -- the file the plan selector replays (ADR-0008 item 8, CONTEXT R-8)
description: The candidates a run evaluates, written down beforehand: for every iteration of the budget, its beams in order, and for every beam the ordered candidate ids it selects; an empty list means the beam matches nothing. Every object is closed. Whether the iterations are numbered 1 to the budget without a gap and whether a beam name repeats inside an iteration depends on the problem spec and is checked by llm4pol.run.selector, not here. A change that a reported result depends on is a new schema version in a new file (charter section 4 A-5), never an edit of this one once results cite it.
